candidate: China Telecom Cloud Computing Inner Mongolia Information Park (中国电信云计算内蒙古信息园), Shengle Modern Service Industry Cluster, Horinger New Area, Hohhot, Inner Mongolia
method: The selected point is the station-centre coordinate of the information park's new (third) 220 kV substation, printed in geographic degrees-minutes-seconds in the environmental impact report form that the Inner Mongolia Department of Ecology and Environment published with its approval result of 7 June 2026 (approval 内环表〔2026〕94号, dated 3 June 2026). It was transcribed arithmetically to decimal degrees with no datum transformation. The report's graticuled evaluation-range figure (附图3, embedded image media/image61.jpeg, 1795 x 1269 px, 5-arc-second graticule) was used for two checks: that the substation is drawn at the printed coordinate, and that the figure's graticule agrees with an independent Esri World Imagery EPSG:4326 export at ground features.

china_telecom_inner_mongolia_information.printed: 地理坐标 电信云计算220kV变电站中心坐标N：40°32'15.394"，E：111°49'51.772" (project table); repeated in section 2 (地理位置) and in the site description (站址中心坐标N：40°32'15.394"，E：111°49'51.772")
china_telecom_inner_mongolia_information.on_campus_statement: The report gives the location as the south-east corner of the B-zone plot of the Inner Mongolia Telecom Cloud Computing Information Park, east section of Yunzhan Road, Shengle Modern Service Industry Cluster (云展路东段内蒙古电信云计算信息园B区地块东南角), and states that the substation is sited inside the information park plant area (本项目变电站选在中国电信云计算内蒙古信息园厂区内), inside the park (位于…信息园园区内部), with the station and its cable routes within the park's land red line and no new land take; construction workers are housed in park buildings and station sewage goes to the park's own treatment plant. The report notes that the design documents call it the park's third 220 kV substation (中国电信云计算内蒙古信息园第三220千伏变电站). Its attachment 6 is the park's 2013 land-use planning permit (地字第150123201300021, Horinger County construction planning bureau, 14 November 2013; land user 中国电信集团公司云计算内蒙古信息园开发建设部; handwritten area 玖拾肆万捌仟贰佰壹拾捌 m2 = 948,218 m2, which is the 1,422.3 mu cited for the park in the 2025 110 kV substation report).

figure_consistency_check.figure: 附图3 评价范围图 (evaluation-range figure on an imagery base with a 5-arc-second graticule); local derived/ct-220kv-eia-fig3-evaluation-range.png

ground_feature_comparison_with_esri.feature: intersection of the north-south road with the diagonal south-west road, south-west of the park
centre of the circular plaza in the north of the park

esri_export.formula: x = (lon - xmin) / (xmax - xmin) * 2000; y = (ymax - lat) / (ymax - ymin) * 1200
esri_export.overlay: local derived/ct-infopark-esri-overlay.png (yellow: selected 220 kV point; red: 2025 110 kV substation point from the cn-north-p1 hold; blue: 220 kV cable start at the overhead terminal tower)
esri_export.observation: Read as WGS84, the point falls in the southern part of a large road-bounded compound of data-centre buildings with a circular plaza in its north, just north of the diagonal road that bounds the compound on the south and east of a row of large halls. Imagery acquisition dates are not stated; the image is used only for the frame check and the campus arrangement, not as a status observation.

figure_consistency_check.internal_line_check: The report's new cable I runs from the overhead terminal tower at 111°50′17.334″E, 40°32′22.641″N to 111°49′51.880″E, 40°32′14.028″N (42 m from the station centre); the terminal tower is 642 m from the centre, consistent with the stated cable lengths of 0.639 km and 0.761 km.
figure_consistency_check.gcj02_alternative: Treating the printed values as GCJ-02 and converting them to WGS84 would move the point about 580 m west-south-west, to 111.824285, 40.536456, onto the road corridor at the compound's south-west corner, outside the park, contradicting the report. The unshifted reading is kept.
figure_consistency_check.conclusion: The printed coordinate is drawn at itself on the report's graticuled figure (within about 3 m) and that graticule agrees with independent WGS84 imagery within about 6 m at two ground features (manual pixel picks). The coordinates are treated as CGCS2000-compatible geographic values. Consistency check only, not a measured accuracy.

relation_to_cn_north_holds: The cn-north-p1 and cn-north-p2 holds used the June 2025 110 kV substation report point (111°49′50.368″E, 40°32′17.373″N), whose report said the station's north side adjoins the park and its other sides were vacant, so it could not serve as an on-campus locator. The selected 220 kV point lies 69 m south-south-east of it, and the 2026 report places it inside the park's land red line in the B-zone plot; the B-zone land south of the 2025 station is therefore treated as park land (the 2025 report's 'vacant land' describes unbuilt land, not land outside the red line). The 110 kV point is not used.
campus_extent_note: In the Esri export the compound extends roughly 800 m west-north-west and 700 m north of the point; the 2013 land-use permit covers 94.8 ha. The point marks on-campus power infrastructure at the park's south side, not an operating data-centre building, entrance or parcel centroid.
reproduction: Text was extracted from word/document.xml of the captured .docx (unzip and regex, no macros or embedded objects opened); images from word/media. Scripts are in local_data/country-research-cn-nm-nx-gs-p3/derived/ (ticks_ct.py, ctred.py, ctcmp.py, overlay_ct.py, gcj.py). Coordinate work ran with uv run --no-project --with pyproj==3.7.1 python -I; image work with uv run --no-project --with pillow==11.0.0 python -I.
